address: Plaza del Poeta Iglesias 12, Salamanca, 37001, Spain
bio: If you like the idea of market-influenced cuisine with a global touch, this restaurant in the heart of the city will undoubtedly appeal. Behind the striking façade of a century-old building is this charming dining space with an eclectic feel split between several floors that in the past was owned by an antique dealer, which explains some of its unusual decorative detail. The cuisine here is showcased exclusively on two menus (De Mercado and Degustación Salamanca), on which we particularly enjoyed the wild sea bass with a mussel beurre blanc, spinach and samphire. Several original private dining rooms are also an option here....
